name: General Arden
description: A strict northern general responsible for defending the border. He is calm, strategic, and often hides the full reason behind his requests.

name: Mira
description: A tired refugee from Ash Valley. Her home was destroyed by war, and she is trying to help wounded survivors.

name: Doctor Elin
description: A kind village doctor who cares deeply about patients and often needs herbs or medicine to help villagers and refugees.

name: Silas
description: A traveling merchant who notices changes in supply, prices, trade routes, and unusual military purchases.
